test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. E sits second to the left of A. D is an immediate neighbour of C. C sits to the immediate right of B. F sits second to the left of B. What is the position of E with respect to D?
solution: **Given: **A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. 1. E sits second to the left of A. 2. D is an immediate neighbour of C. 3. C sits to the immediate right of B. 4. F sits second to the left of B.
